items.title: Albert Artigues Sr. Interview, 1961-12-15
items.q: The interviewee addresses 'Paul' multiple times (e.g., 'You don't need a piano, Paul', 'You know that, Paul'), indicating Paul Crawford is the interviewer. The interviewee does not describe a personal or professional relationship with the interviewer beyond the context of the interview itself.

ctx.x: Around them Mommaloos in that area?

That's right. And we had Bill on bass, myself on trumpet, Johnny McGee playing clarinet, Tony Shrine on drums, and Sam Callie on guitar. You ever hear him play guitar? I think a long time ago with you. Oh man, he sounds like a piano man on a guitar. You don't need a piano, Paul, when you play with him. Really nice. He still plays nice.

Is it Gene Hemard or what is his name, Hemard? Gene Ory or whatever he tells himself he used to play with you some? He played guitar. I think he played with you or Red Hot. Maybe I got it confused. He played with Red Hot.
